name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceUploadPictureActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user reaches the screenshot-check step of an advertised app-experience task. It lets the user choose or submit a screenshot for verification before a task reward is paid.
disableEffect: Users will not be able to submit the screenshot or receive this experience-task reward.
